{{Top|leg}}
A '''nursery ring''' was a facility where young [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were raised. [[Gender/Legends|Males]] engaged in rough-and-tumble play at nursery rings and developed fearlessly headlong fighting styles. One such [[Wookiee nursery ring|nursery ring]] was in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Rwookrrorro/Legends|Rwookrrorro]]. [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]] worked in another ring in a village nearby to Rwookrrorro before she [[Wedding of Chewbacca and Mallatobuck|wed]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]].
